description: Lists the market cards of the Arquestra Consulting Market Radar: public consulting contracts in Europe from EUR 15,000 up, one card per country and kind of work (all, strategy, transformation, platform, build_run), with headline figures (awards in 24 months, open calls now, median value, median bids, single-bid share, Big Four share, SME share) and the links to each card and its page. Filter by country or kind.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-3 or alpha-2 code, or a country name; ALL for Europe; EUI for the EU institutions.

lang.description: Language of the page links (the data is the same). Default en.
